title: Two orders in one tree
hook: Each node has a search key and a separate priority.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Binary search-tree ordering; subtree size and interval notation.
doesNotKnow: Restore independent search-key and heap-priority invariants after a treap insertion.

misconception: A random priority replaces the search-key ordering.
objective: Restore independent search-key and heap-priority invariants after a treap insertion.

claims.text: Search-tree order chooses where the new key attaches. Rotations then restore the independent minimum-priority heap order without changing the inorder key sequence.
